GeneralInformation.Description: Lyrion Helper. Per-room extension device hosting the rich Crestron Home media-player UI (now-playing metadata, transport, shuffle, repeat, power) for a single Lyrion player. Bound by MAC address; consumes the Lyrion Server gateway service. Companion to the Lyrion Source and Lyrion Receiver drivers.

UserAttributes.Label: Player MAC Address
UserAttributes.Description: MAC address of the Lyrion player for this room (form aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff). Must match the Lyrion Source and Lyrion Receiver drivers for the same room.

UserAttributes.Label: Preset 1
UserAttributes.Description: Optional playlist/favourite shortcut, as Name|Icon|Command — e.g. KCRW|icBroadcastRegular|favorites playlist play item_id:2. The command is the LMS CLI text that follows the player MAC; do not include the MAC or a line feed. Leave the icon empty for the default. Leave the whole field empty to hide this preset.

UserAttributes.Label: Preset 2
UserAttributes.Description: Optional playlist/favourite shortcut, as Name|Icon|Command. See Preset 1.

UserAttributes.Label: Preset 3
UserAttributes.Description: Optional playlist/favourite shortcut, as Name|Icon|Command. See Preset 1.

UserAttributes.Label: Preset 4
UserAttributes.Description: Optional playlist/favourite shortcut, as Name|Icon|Command. See Preset 1.
